assessment: Outcome payment could favor selection correctness or faster recovery. Assignment changes and renaming correlate with affected exports; causation and implementation feasibility remain unproven. The sample does not establish isolation for split courses.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: a fixed fee with a holdback tied to the stated outcome across a predeclared 40-export cohort would favor a center/week course manifest independent of displayed names and current instructor assignment.
openings.delta: Reward preventing rework. Gaming could exclude difficult exports, redefine intended sets, or transfer checking to coordinators; retain every cohort export and count checking time.
openings.prediction: If selection semantics explain the association, a reconciled weekly manifest reduces reassignment and rename omissions without increasing handling time.
openings.probe: In first coordinator sessions, reconcile fabricated intended sets before revealing outputs. Compare incumbent and manifest selection on reassignment, rename, and split cases; check unauthorized-center exclusion, unchanged CSV imports, and concurrent attendance entry.
assumptions: Stable course identity and week-specific evidence exist or can be captured within six engineer-days and existing hosting.
Participant names remain private and authorized; selection reads do not block attendance entry.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: holding back payment until a correction produces a usable file would favor authorized private self-service correction and regeneration using the documented CSV schema.
openings.delta: Reward restoring usability. Gaming could close requests after fast but unchanged exports; require intended-set and import checks and count all correction time.
openings.prediction: If request handling dominates recovery, corrected files arrive sooner; active handling may remain unchanged if checking and importing dominate.
openings.probe: In second sessions, compare provider-mediated and self-service recovery on fabricated incorrect exports. Separately time active work and elapsed recovery; verify sets, imports, isolation, and simultaneous attendance entry. Repeated identical omissions reject regeneration alone as sufficient.
assumptions: A bounded correction interface and export execution fit six engineer-days and existing hosting.
Corrections can be restricted to authorized center/week selection without stopping attendance entry.
